Zscaler and other SSL-inspection proxies follow the redirect and must also reach this S3 bucket. CRITICAL: This affects every VCF customer with SSL inspection enabled — LCM updates, VKS node packages, OS patches will silently fail if this bucket is blocked. Fix: add packages.broadcom.com to SSL bypass list (preferred), OR whitelist this S3 bucket. [Bypass SSL]
